subject.title: WhatsApp: Gemini thinking tags (<think>/<final>) still leak after #6328 fix

question: What should strict sanitizer recovery do when a reply has an unclosed reasoning tag followed by a `<final>` boundary: return only the final body, suppress the malformed payload, or keep the current post-opener recovery fallback?
rationale: This is a security boundary choice because one behavior can leak hidden reasoning while the other can drop or truncate the user's answer; code alone cannot choose the intended product tradeoff safely.

options.title: Recover only final answer text
options.body: Change shared strict recovery to use a valid `<final>` body when present, drop preceding reasoning, and add WhatsApp/Telegram/WebChat coverage for malformed tag turns.

options.title: Fail closed on malformed reasoning
options.body: Suppress the entire malformed payload when reasoning is unclosed, accepting possible message loss to avoid private reasoning exposure.

options.title: Keep current recovery behavior
options.body: Leave the answer-recovery fallback in place and rely on native Gemini mode/provider fixes to reduce the malformed tagged input source.

recommendation.title: Recover only final answer text
recommendation.body: Change shared strict recovery to use a valid `<final>` body when present, drop preceding reasoning, and add WhatsApp/Telegram/WebChat coverage for malformed tag turns.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is centered on shared final/reasoning sanitizer semantics where this owner has the strongest sampled feature history.
